findings.title: Same-tenant invoice disclosure
findings.expected: Only the owner may read an invoice, including for admin. Source: app/README.md.
findings.observed: Alice read inv-b: HTTP 200, owner bob.
evidence: baseline-evidence.json (source hash, environment, selected observed fields)
reproduction: GET /invoices/inv-b as Alice; compare with authorized GET /invoices/inv-a.
Run python reproduce.py locally; current source demonstrates the fixed result.
preconditions: Authenticated account in the same tenant as another owner.
uncertainty: Demonstrated only against synthetic local fixtures; production exploitability is not assessed.
findings.impact: Disclosure of another owner invoice within a tenant.
findings.remediation: Applied tenant and owner checks; full account/invoice matrix passes.

findings.title: Client-controlled order totals
findings.expected: Order totals equal quantity times catalog price. Source: app/README.md.
findings.observed: Quantity 2 and submitted price 1 produced total 2 rather than 2000.
evidence: baseline-evidence.json (source hash, environment, selected observed fields)
reproduction: POST /orders as Alice with sku book, quantity 2, unit_price_cents 1; inspect total.
Run python reproduce.py locally; current source demonstrates the fixed result.
preconditions: Authenticated purchaser submitting a valid noncatalog price.
uncertainty: Demonstrated only against synthetic local fixtures; production exploitability is not assessed.
findings.impact: Order-integrity failure; no actual financial loss tested.
findings.remediation: Applied catalog-derived totals; low, exact, and high submitted prices pass regression checks.
